name: io.github.mundanebcdev/business-central-deployment-tool
title: Business Central Deployment Tool
description: Deploy Business Central per-tenant extensions, inspect apps and operation details, and download AL symbols.

environmentVariables.name: BC_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential type used against the Admin Center API.

environmentVariables.name: BC_TENANT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Microsoft Entra tenant ID that owns the Business Central environments.

environmentVariables.name: BC_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret for the Entra application. Omit when using certificate or managed identity auth.

environmentVariables.name: BC_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a PFX certificate used instead of a client secret.

environmentVariables.name: BC_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Optional password protecting the PFX certificate.

environmentVariables.name: BC_ALLOWED_APP_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Path-separated directories the server may read .app and .zip packages from.

environmentVariables.name: BC_ALLOWED_SYMBOL_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Path-separated directories the server may write downloaded AL symbols to.

environmentVariables.name: BC_ALLOW_PRODUCTION_DEPLOYMENT
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to permit deployments to Production environments. Defaults to false.

environmentVariables.name: BC_DEPLOYMENT_JOURNAL_DIRECTORY
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the JSON Lines deployment recovery journal.
